beginner.jumpAndRegister: inherited from Very Easy RH; no extra Beginner revoice

A.name: midpoint-ladder-tolerance
A.derivation: midpoint between Beginner 0.02 and Very Easy 0.13; no other value changes
A.purpose: test whether Cover's RH loss is primarily a timing-ladder cliff

B.name: one-lh-anchor-per-measure

exactChange.lhPolicy: add at most one lowest VE LH note from the first LH onset in each source measure-sized window

B.derivation: smallest existing sparse-anchor representation; no scalar budget changes
B.purpose: test whether RH-only policy causes active LH-only passages such as Case 05 to disappear

C.name: midpoint-plus-one-lh-anchor
C.exactChange: combine candidates A and B without any additional tuning
C.purpose: test whether the two independently demonstrated binders need both minimal relaxations

identity: active source windows with zero output

successCriteria.materialIdentityGain: at least +0.10 RH onset coverage or recovery of at least 10% of the fixture's lost RH proxy events, plus reduced active-passage erasure
successCriteria.playability: no maxSimultaneity or span/jump violation; candidate attack rate may rise only within its preregistered envelope
successCriteria.neighborSeparation: candidate remains below Very Easy on notes/onsets/attack rate and above Very Beginner on at least one complexity dimension
successCriteria.crossFixture: no structural identity or playability regression on Classical, Pop, or Synthetic shadow
successCriteria.promotion: one candidate satisfies all gates; otherwise no production change

failureCriteria: candidate collapses into Very Easy or Very Beginner
productionChange: none unless exactly one candidate passes all promotion criteria
